text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well then, don't mind if I take you up on 
that and get some rest. 'Night~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ngh? Huh, what was I doing again?

text_block_list.name: Show Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Now then! Here comes our challenger for 
the "100 Rapid-Fire Gags", Nice Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see... I finally got to appear on this 
legendary show, right? ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Nice Nature. Shall we engage in a 
battle of wits and jokes?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I was raised working at a 
downtown shop. Don't you dare 
underestimate the instincts I honed 
dealing with customers!

Was it the power of dreams...? The 
surprisingly eager buzz-in gag battle 
ended in a fierce deadlock—

text_block_list.name: Show Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the final theme that will decide 
your fate is— ..."Trainer"!!
(Ding-dooong!!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer used a tracer to turn the dresser 
into a trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Kukuku! Trainer is a tracer... 
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Show Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"There it is~!! The legendary Royal 
Straight Flush Gag! A magnificent 
victory!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Aha, I ended up winning.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand it at all... but why am 
I... so ridiculously happy about this...?

Thanks to the delightful dream, she seemed 
to have gotten a full breather.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I got pushed back~~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Whether in races or in comedy, 
speed is everything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... What was that just now?

Stunned by the utter absurdity of the 
dream and its ending, Nice Nature was left 
completely dumbfounded...
